name: 陳生明
objective: Two major goals of this course are spectroscopy and separation methods. Spectroscopy methods include ultraviolet, visible, infrared, nuclear magnetic, and x-ray spectroscopies.Election and mass spectrometry are also included. Separation methods are: gas, liquid, and gel chromatographies. In addition, GC-MS,LC-MS, GC-IR, etc. will be studied.
課程進度(1-16週):
First week: Introduction
Second week: Raman spectroscopy 
Third week: UV- Visible spectroscopy
Fourth week: Infrared spectroscopy
Fifth week:Chromatography techniques
Sixth week: AFM in detailed study
Seventh week: STM in detailed study
Eighth week: SEM applications
Ninth week: Mid-term presentation
Tenth week: TEM applications
Eleventh week: XPS in detailed study
Twelfth week:ATR in detailed study
Thirteenth week: XRD in detailed study
Fourteenth week: Mass spectroscopy in detailed study
Fifteenth week: CV in detailed study
Sixteenth week: Presentations Q&A
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          Seventeenth week:
Students will work in groups to discuss course-related topics, supplemented by online course materials, to deepen their understanding of advanced instrumental analysis.

Eighteenth week:
Students will select an instrument introduced during Weeks 1–16 for hands-on operation.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          Students will be able to organize and analyze experimental results after completing the experiment and prepare and submit a comprehensive experimental report.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          Written Reports:------------------------ 15%
Experimental results:-------------------15%
